statement: ∀ (a b c : Nat), a ∣ b → b ∣ c → a ∣ c
reference_proof:
intro a b c hab hbc
obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hab
obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hbc
exact ⟨x * y, by ring⟩
note: 整除传递；两步 obtain 会留下子目标流

statement: ∀ (a b : Nat), a ∣ b → a ∣ b + a
reference_proof:
intro a b hab
obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hab
exact ⟨c + 1, by ring⟩

intro a b h
rw [Nat.mul_eq_zero] at h
exact h

intro n hn
obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hn
rw [pow_two]
exact ⟨2 * k * k, by ring⟩
note: 偶数平方仍是偶数（构造见证）

reference_proof:
intro n
rw [pow_two]
have h : n * n + n = n * (n + 1) := by ring
rw [h]
exact even_iff_two_dvd.mp (Nat.even_mul_succ_self n)
note: G1 里没过的经典题的修好版（用 mp 而不是 rw）
